turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Any tricks for cheap cinema tickets? I'm a student and they cost a fortune.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Plenty. Student discounts are common, so always carry your card and ask.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then look at weekday matinees, they're often much cheaper. Some cinemas have one discount day a week, often Tuesday.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If you go more than twice a month, they usually pay for themselves. Just check the small print, some exclude the big premium screens.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And snacks, can I bring my own?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Some cinemas allow it, some don't. Check their rules, and if they're strict, eat before you go.
